board.digest_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(messages with sequence<=max_sequence, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
board.read_through: GitRefDurableStateStore.read_revision(work-engine/codex-chatboard/v1, store_revision) + codex_chatboard.decode (git ref store, namespace codex-chatboard); live adapter read is a cross-check only

line_rule: a file's frozen prefix is its first `lines` newline-terminated lines; `sha256`/`bytes` describe that prefix
